llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define auth screens in createNativeStackNavigator static config using screen-level `if` hooks (e.g., signed-in screens vs signed-out screens).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Neither Login nor Home screens use `if` hooks (e.g., `if: useIsSignedOut` / `if: useIsSignedIn`) in the static navigator config. The `if` property is absent from both screen definitions.
evidence: screens: { Login: { screen: LoginScreen, options: { headerShown: false } }, Home: HomeScreen }

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must maintain authentication state and derive route availability from that state (signed in/out conditions).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: `isSignedIn` state in App is propagated via AuthContext and consumed by hooks `useIsSignedIn`/`useIsSignedOut`, establishing a single source of truth for auth state. However, route availability is not actually derived from it (no `if` guards), so this partially passes only on the state management aspect.
evidence: const useIsSignedIn = () => { const { isSignedIn } = useAuthContext(); return isSignedIn }

llmJudgeRequirements.description: After successful login, Home must become the active available route and Login must no longer be available.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Without `if` guards on screens, both Login and Home remain available regardless of auth state. Home does not become the exclusively active route after login via route config; only an imperative `navigation.navigate('Home')` is attempted in `onReady`, which is not triggered on sign-in.
evidence: screens: { Login: { ... }, Home: HomeScreen } — no conditional inclusion
navigation.navigate('Home') only in onReady, not on sign-in event

llmJudgeRequirements.description: After successful login, back navigation must not return to Login.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Login screen is always present in the navigator with no `if` guard to remove it after sign-in, so back navigation could return to Login. No mechanism prevents this.
evidence: Login screen defined without `if: useIsSignedOut` guard
No stack reset or screen removal logic on sign-in

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must not imperatively navigate to Home/SignIn for core auth transition when using `if`-guarded routes; route switch should occur from auth state change.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The code attempts imperative navigation (`navigation.navigate('Home')`) in `onReady`, and does NOT use `if`-guarded routes for the auth transition. The requirement forbids imperative navigation when using `if` guards, but here there are no `if` guards at all, and imperative navigation is still present.
evidence: No `if` hooks on any screen definition
